milestone.title: Theme system follow-up — per-component accent roles (focus_ring + surface_1 + surface_2)

intent.outcome: Palette gains three quiet roles — focus_ring, surface_1, surface_2 — populated for every palette (including monochrome), and the list, overlay, board, detail, and chrome renderers use them so focus and nested panels read as distinct layers instead of everything collapsing onto accent / foreground / dim.

problem.description: crates/raul/src/theme.rs::Palette has six roles (accent, success, warn, danger, dim, foreground). Renderers therefore draw selection highlights, focused chips, modal/overlay surfaces, and nested panels with the same accent/foreground/dim colors, and never set a background, so layers are indistinguishable and the UI is loud. The official palettes define quiet layering colors that raul ignores (Catppuccin Lavender / Mantle / Surface0; Dracula and Alucard Background Light / Selection).

in_scope: Add focus_ring, surface_1, surface_2 to Palette with role doc comments (focus_ring: focused chip / selected-row border and marker; surface_1: overlay, modal, and picker background; surface_2: selected-row / hover background inside a surface).

Values — latte: 0x7287fd / 0xe6e9ef / 0xccd0da; frappe: 0xbabbf1 / 0x292c3c / 0x414559; macchiato: 0xb7bdf8 / 0x1e2030 / 0x363a4f; mocha: 0xb4befe / 0x181825 / 0x313244 (Lavender / Mantle / Surface0); dracula: 0x8be9fd / 0x343746 / 0x44475a; alucard: 0x036a96 / 0xdedccf / 0xcfcfde (Cyan / Background Light / Selection per draculatheme.com/spec); monochrome: Color::Reset for all three (monochrome relies on modifiers).

Renderer adoption: lane_lists.rs and board.rs selected row → surface_2 bg + focus_ring marker; overlays.rs and modal.rs → surface_1 bg; milestone_detail.rs / detail_sections.rs focused AC row → surface_2 bg; chrome.rs header/footer → surface_1 bg; dashboard_view.rs / tab_bar.rs focused tab → focus_ring; path_view.rs connector → dim (unchanged) and selected node → focus_ring; settings theme picker (M243) → surface_1 bg, focus_ring on the highlighted row, swatch row extended to 9 roles.
Unit tests in crates/raul/src/theme.rs: exact values per palette, and a non-degenerate check that for every named palette surface_1 ≠ surface_2 ≠ foreground and focus_ring ≠ accent.
Render tests (TestBackend) proving the roles land in cells and follow a live palette swap.
docs/raul/settings.md: a role table (role → where it is used).
out_of_scope: Autopilot lane surfaces from M241/M242 — they adopt the roles in their own milestones or a follow-up.
Terminal capability detection, custom user palettes, new light/dark variants.
Changing the six existing role values (Frappe dim is fixed in M243).
A stylesheet / theme override file format.

acceptance_criteria.description: Palette has focus_ring, surface_1, surface_2 with the exact per-palette values in scope for all 7 palettes (6 named + monochrome).

Selected list/board rows use surface_2 bg + focus_ring marker; overlays/modals and chrome use surface_1 bg; focused detail rows use surface_2; focused tabs use focus_ring (TestBackend cell assertions).
The Settings theme picker draws on surface_1, marks the highlighted row with focus_ring, and its swatch shows all 9 roles.
For every named palette surface_1, surface_2, and foreground are pairwise distinct and focus_ring differs from accent.
Swapping App::palette at runtime changes the role colors in the next rendered frame; docs/raul/settings.md has the role table.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast --test tui_palette_roles -E 'test(/live_swap/)' && rg -q 'surface_1' docs/raul/settings.md

acceptance_criteria.description: raul tests, clippy, fmt, and consumer-surface lint are clean.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast && cargo clippy -p raul --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all -- --check && make consumer-surface-lint
